from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

MAIN = '797c5e846c35ab970dac3b8cff5260c3347b1adf'
PUB = 'b94fe8dbf3cf197cc4833ccebd657dc855ba6eb7'
TIP = 'faadd9c9461f7091ff676e010c03365492aebb74'
OUT = Path('/tmp/pr453-recovery-audit-20260916-inventory.json')

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True)

def blob(sha, path):
    return git('show', sha + ':' + path)

def headers(text):
    pattern = r'(?m)^(?:@\[[^\n]*\]\s*)?(?:noncomputable )?(?:theorem|def|lemma|abbrev) ([^\s:{(]+)'
    result = {}
    for match in re.finditer(pattern, text):
        end = text.find(':=', match.end())
        if end >= 0:
            result[match.group(1)] = ' '.join(text[match.start():end].split())
    return result

paths = ['MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean',
         'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ExtendedLineGame/PointPointRejection.lean']
result = {'main': MAIN, 'public': PUB, 'local': TIP, 'public_header_checks': {}}
for path in paths:
    before, after = blob(PUB, path), blob(TIP, path)
    a, b = headers(before), headers(after)
    result['public_header_checks'][path] = {
        'public_declarations': list(b), 'all_public_headers_identical': a == b,
        'sorry_tokens_public': len(re.findall(r'\bsorry\b', before)),
        'sorry_tokens_local': len(re.findall(r'\bsorry\b', after)),
        'local_sha256': hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest()}
    assert a == b, path

support = ['NondegeneratePastingMass', 'RestrictedAverage', 'RestrictedMixture',
           'ConsistencyPositivity', 'ZeroDirectionMass']
result['support'] = {}
for name in support:
    path = 'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/' + name + '.lean'
    main, local = blob(MAIN, path), blob(TIP, path)
    a, b = headers(main), headers(local)
    result['support'][path] = {
        'same_file': main == local,
        'common_headers_identical': all(a[n] == b[n] for n in a.keys() & b.keys()),
        'local_only_names': sorted(b.keys() - a.keys()),
        'main_only_names': sorted(a.keys() - b.keys()),
        'main_sha256': hashlib.sha256(main.encode()).hexdigest(),
        'local_sha256': hashlib.sha256(local.encode()).hexdigest(),
        'local_public_names': list(b)}

result['source_hashes'] = {}
for path in ['references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex',
             'references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex',
             'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/LineDefs.lean',
             'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/ExpandedDefs.lean',
             'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Witnesses.lean',
             'MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistributionAux.lean']:
    a, b = blob(MAIN, path), blob(TIP, path)
    result['source_hashes'][path] = {'same_file': a == b,
                                    'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b.encode()).hexdigest()}

checks = [('9122293be4972f83838603ec02e4566c663ae029', PUB),
          ('63139db3f1f2cb44acd5e04f123c202f2b7cb9a4', MAIN),
          ('f5904fc9722d563489742dfca1e24a495a0624b8', MAIN), (PUB, TIP)]
result['ancestry_for_history_only'] = [
    {'ancestor': a, 'descendant': b,
     'returncode': subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', a, b], cwd=ROOT).returncode}
    for a, b in checks]
result['main_local_merge_bases'] = git('merge-base', '--all', MAIN, TIP).splitlines()
result['blueprint_changes_vs_reported_pr_base'] = git(
    'diff', '--name-only', '5922ecc4d5692d1f0a66d853c90bf7a24952159b', TIP, '--', 'blueprint').splitlines()
result['local_head'] = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip()
result['local_status'] = git('status', '--porcelain')
assert result['local_head'] == TIP and not result['local_status']
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
